title: Exact memory fact read response
description: internal/server/memory.ReadMemoryFactResponse. Live-only: a missing, private, expired, or canceled fact instead returns the shared memory_verbs error envelope with error="unavailable", never a distinct shape per reason.

id.description: The opaque fact_id (SHA256) -- the canonical form, regardless of which valid id shape the request used.

visibility.description: Always "world": a private fact is reported unavailable, never returned.

content_untrusted.description: Always true: raw attributed input, never verified evidence or an accepted claim.
